Alamo,_Nevada.title: Alamo, Nevada
Alamo,_Nevada.summary: Alamo is an unincorporated town in Lincoln County, Nevada, United States, about 90 miles (140 km) north of Las Vegas along U.S. Route 93. As of the 2010 census it had a population of 1,080.

Amargosa_Valley,_Nevada.title: Amargosa Valley, Nevada
Amargosa_Valley,_Nevada.summary: Amargosa Valley is an unincorporated town located on U.S. Route 95 in Nye County, in the U.S. state of Nevada.

Austin,_Nevada.title: Austin, Nevada
Austin,_Nevada.summary: Austin is an unincorporated town and census-designated place in and the former county seat of Lander County, Nevada, United States. In 2020, the place had a population of 167. It is located on the western slopes of the Toiyabe Range at an elevation of 6,575 feet (2,004 m); U.S. Route 50 passes through.
